title: Keyless evals certify their own recorded measurement, not a hand-typed one
deviations_from_card: (1) `deterministic` and `recorder` live on the Bar in thresholds.py (a property of the eval), not in measurements.json; the JSON carries measured/n/measured_at/source/corpus only. (2) Case 6 is pinned through bind_measurements(records), the exact function module import calls, rather than by re-importing with a patched file. (3) Added test_fault_eval.py (fault_eval's own tests, allowed) for the fault n-check and the --mode refusal. (4) Case 7 is strengthened per the critic's 'trivially satisfiable' note: the gated-module list is parsed from package.json test:eval:ci, each must be the recorder of a deterministic bar AND call settle_live, and behavioural stale-record tests exist for all four evals (matching/automation/fault/intake --strict exit 1). (5) INTAKE_THRESHOLD gates on the CHECK pass rate with n = check count (98), not persona count, so a dropped assertion moves n; validated as non-tunable 1.0 like FAULT_THRESHOLD. (6) Docstring '25-point' corrected to '26-point' to match the bar's own why.
notes: Recorded today's live values, verified by running each eval's --record against the committed file: every one reported 'record already matches; nothing re-dated' (matching 1.0/7, entry_precision 1.0/4, relevance 0.857/7; reliability 1.0/42; fault 1.0/240; intake 1.0/98). No bar value or slack changed; the gate only gains a staleness check. --record refuses when CI or GITHUB_ACTIONS is set (exit 2, file untouched) and on non-canonical runs. `CI=true npm run test:eval:ci` = 0; full `python -m pytest pipeline/jobfit/tests` = 2898 passed; `CI=true npm run test:python:gate` = 0 with 4 skips (floor/ceiling 4-5, no new skips). Of 25 new cases, 20 were observed red before the build; 3 (matching strict green, intake strict green, the test:eval:ci module list) were green before by design (they pin that the tightened gate stays green); the 2 fault cases were written after the build and not observed red. Node gates red on FOREIGN paths only, this card touched no TS/JS: test:unit = 1 from a FLAKE in app/_lib/db/core-boot-tail.test.ts; test:perf = 1 from app/page.tsx 8853 KB vs ceiling 8852 KB (import graph of TS; a sibling's in-flight or committed work, nothing under pipeline/ is in that graph). No feature-doc-map entry covers pipeline/jobfit/eval/*; the doc update went to docs/development/testing-and-evaluation.md under the lock, committed alone.
